declaration.argument: Only how the history writer encodes pages and how trace rows carry function names change. In a vendored copy of parquet 58.0.0, integer dictionary keys come from a last-value memo and a direct table for values in [-1, 65,535) instead of hashing, and string page min/max are compared only for keys new to the page, with identical keys, statistics and column indexes; contiguous primitive gathers write the source slice. Trace function names are process-wide static strings instead of shared reference counts. No draw, value, row, container order or anything the search reads changes. One-thread identity against the baseline binary on VR (3,008 runs), Mencius (2,160 runs), a crash-heavy session (1,800 runs) and a caps-engaged VR session of 100,000 runs: every executions, logs and traces parquet file byte-identical, the runs file differing only in wall columns, every table identical, same stall_cap_runs.csv hashes, equal end reasons, steps and cap figures, runs_failed 0.
